info.name: ERBM Advance API
info.description: Advance API collection for the ERBM backend. Set baseUrl, accessToken, and projectId before use. Create Advance saves advanceId for detail, editing, submission and combined action/submission history. Submit requires the PC creator who is still assigned to the Project.

request.description: Use a PM accessToken for the approval screen. The existing Advance list filters PENDING_PM_APPROVAL by Projects currently managed by that PM. Includes standard pagination; an empty list returns data: [] and total: 0.

Use a PC accessToken. Lists RETURNED_FOR_REVISION Advances in Projects where that PC is currently assigned. Read return reasons with GET /advances/{id}/history; review actions use their corresponding POST APIs.
Use an ACCOUNTING accessToken. Lists approved Advances using the existing status filter. Confirmation of disbursement is a separate action.
ADMIN and ACCOUNTING can list every accessible Advance. PM sees managed Projects; PC sees assigned Projects. DRAFT records remain visible only to their creator.
Requires the authenticated PC to be the Project's assigned coordinator. On a 201 response, the test script stores data.id in advanceId.
Uses advanceId. DRAFT records are visible only to the creator. PM and PC also require current Project membership.
Uses advanceId. Only the PC creator who remains assigned to the Project can update a DRAFT or RETURNED_FOR_REVISION Advance. Omit purpose or amount to retain its current value.
No body required. Submits DRAFT to PENDING_PM_APPROVAL and saves an immutable revision. Returned requests must be edited to DRAFT first. Repeated submission returns 409.
Use the Project's current PM accessToken. No body required. Only PENDING_PM_APPROVAL can become APPROVED. Repeated or conflicting review returns 409.
Use the Project's current PM accessToken. Requires a nonblank reason. Only PENDING_PM_APPROVAL can become RETURNED_FOR_REVISION. The reason and action are saved atomically in audit history.

Uses advanceId. Returns every workflow action, newest first by occurred_at and event ID. Includes actor, previous/resulting status, reason and timestamp. SUBMIT also includes revision (numbered from 1 per Advance in event-ID order), amount and purpose from that round. Submission fields are null for other actions; missing snapshot fields remain null. Same Project assignment and private-DRAFT policy as GET detail. No pagination or full audit snapshots. Replaces the separate revisions endpoint.

exec: pm.test('submission purpose', () => pm.expect(item.purpose === null || typeof item.purpose === 'string').to.eql(true));
pm.test('no submission data for other actions', () => { pm.expect(item.revision).to.eql(null); pm.expect(item.purpose).to.eql(null); });
